tier_description: Rendered, sampled. Reported separately from Tier A. The Tier A result must not lend this one its credibility, nor the reverse.

implementation.rendering: Offscreen MTLTexture, rgba8Unorm, read back to CPU. No window, no display. Shaders compiled at runtime via makeLibrary(source:) because this machine has no offline Metal compiler.

sample.phase_note: Phase computed as wrap(t * motionSpeed) and set directly. The clock is never waited on.

negative_controls.note: Two controls failed to fire on their first attempt and were corrected. Both failures were in the control designs, not the checks. Detail in that file.

results.constructional_validity_note: Every one of the 2,000 sampled seeds fails on at least one surface. Constructional validity, as the protocol defines it, does not hold at Tier B.

predictions.text: Containment fails for at least one seed. Predicted: FAIL.
predictions.outcome: FAILED as predicted, but by a mechanism the prediction got wrong.
predictions.measured: 10,000 of 10,000 phone-portrait frames clip - every seed, every moment. Zero clipping on mac-landscape and zero on square.
predictions.why_the_prediction_was_wrong: The prediction expected a seed-dependent failure, worst on the square surface. It is not seed-dependent at all, and square had none. At camera distance 5.5 with a 45 degree vertical field of view the visible half-width at z=0 is about 1.025 on a 1080x2400 aspect, which is below the primitive's fixed maximum radius of 1.1. No style parameter can change the form's extent, so the form cannot fit that aspect for any seed.
predictions.scored_as: Right about the outcome, wrong about the mechanism. Recorded as such rather than claimed as a hit.

predictions.text: Rendered figure/ground collapse occurs even though Tier A passes T6. Predicted: FAIL, small count.
predictions.measured: 584 frames across 43 distinct seeds (2.15% of the sample). Separations 0.0319 to 0.0798 against a 0.08 floor - below the line, none catastrophic. Distributed evenly across surfaces (202/191/191) and across moments (116-119 each), so it is a property of the seed's colour rather than of framing or timing.
predictions.significance: Tier A separates HSL parameters and passed all 100,000 seeds on T6. The rendered pixel additionally passes through opacity, transmission, rim and blending, and 2.15% of seeds lose their separation there. A parameter-level contract is not a substitute for a rendered one.
predictions.note_on_the_frozen_suspicion: The freeze committed to suspecting this check if it returned zero. It did not return zero, and its negative control fires, so the check is doing work.

predictions.measured: 0 mismatches over 100 seeds re-rendered in-process. 1,500 frames (100 seeds x 3 surfaces x 5 moments) fingerprinted in two separate process invocations and byte-identical, which is the 'across process restarts' the freeze asked for.

predictions.text: Coverage is broad, not clustered. Predicted: PASS, weakly held.
predictions.outcome: PASSED, but the luminance margin is thin.
predictions.measured: Hue: 36 of 36 buckets occupied. Luminance: p05 0.1470, p95 0.3869, span 0.2398 against a falsification threshold of 0.2233 (a third of the 0.67 declared lightness span).
predictions.caveat: The luminance span clears the threshold by about 7%. Coverage is not comfortable here, and a constitution change that narrows the lightness ranges could push it under.

predictions.text: No rejection path exists. Predicted: PASS.
predictions.outcome: PASSED, by inspection rather than by measurement.
predictions.measured: Every occurrence of retry/resample/reject/repair vocabulary in the target is a comment. Every use of a violation list is a count, a record, or a control assertion; none is a branch that redraws or discards.
predictions.caveat: This is a reading of the source, not an observation of behaviour. It is the weakest evidence in this file.

what_this_does_not_establish: Nothing here says the output is any good. Geometric containment and pixel distinctness are measurable; whether the fish reads as a fish, or is worth looking at, is not. D-P-01 remains open and unaccepted.
The 2,000-seed sample is small against a 64-bit seed space, and Tier A's 100,000-seed pass says nothing about these rendered failures.

R2's 0.08 floor is inherited from the Tier A threshold. Whether 0.08 of luminance separation is the right floor for a rendered membrane over a dark ground has not been established by anything except consistency with the parameter check.
